note: In the Ten Lakes area of the Kootenai NF, 12.5 air miles from Fortine; tables, fire rings, food storage boxes and undeveloped boat access (pack boats) on Little Therriault Lake. Reached via ~28 mi of gravel forest road — passable by passenger cars in dry conditions, not high-clearance-only. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated February 18, 2025) confirms $10/night, 6 sites, 32-ft RV max, Senior/Access 50% discount. Added season year-round (managed June 29 - Labor Day, available all year, weather dependent) and the 14-day stay limit. Facilities left as is: the page contradicts itself on water (see flag); vault toilets stated in its description. Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived FCFS left). No Kootenai NF alert or flood washout listed for the Ten Lakes roads. Note trimmed of restated sites, facilities, length, FCFS and fee.
